response.sql: WITH per_scan AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin AS gbpm FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0), op AS (SELECT s.crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_cnt, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_gbpm FROM scans s WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gbpm) AS overall_avg FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.scan_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(op.avg_gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_gbpm - overall.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM op CROSS JOIN overall WHERE op.avg_gbpm > overall.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: Scans with NULL gbsize or NULL/zero spanmin are ignored entirely, so each operator's scan count only includes scans that have a valid gb-per-minute value (the count and the average are computed over the same set of scans).
The 'simple average across all operators' is the unweighted mean of each operator's average GB per minute (one value per operator), not the mean over all scans.
Operator's average GB per minute is the mean of per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios, not total GB divided by total minutes.

alternatives.interpretation: Scan count is the total number of scan records per operator (including those with missing gbsize/spanmin), while the average GB per minute uses only valid scans.
alternatives.sql: WITH cnt AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_cnt FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), rate AS (SELECT crewref, AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS avg_gbpm FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY crewref), op AS (SELECT c.crewref, c.scan_cnt, r.avg_gbpm FROM cnt c JOIN rate r ON r.crewref = c.crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gbpm) AS overall_avg FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.scan_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(op.avg_gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_gbpm - overall.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM op CROSS JOIN overall WHERE op.avg_gbpm > overall.overall_avg
